title: Viture, which ranked top in XR glasses shipments in the US in Q3 2025, per IDC, raised $100M, bringing its funding in the past six months to $200M (Charlie Fink/Forbes)
summary: Charlie Fink / Forbes: Viture, which ranked top in XR glasses shipments in the US in Q3 2025, per IDC, raised $100M, bringing its funding in the past six months to $200M — Viture has closed another $100 million financing round, bringing its total capital raised in the past six months to more than $200 million …
